title: TigreBet
shortDescription: Produto de jogos online onde o jogador entra, aposta via PIX e sobe de nivel VIP. 11 jogos, provably fair e saques com KYC.
problemDescription: O desafio era construir uma plataforma completa de jogos online que combinasse performance de um frontend moderno com a seguranca de um backend robusto. A plataforma precisava suportar 11 jogos diferentes (Fortune Tiger, Crash, Plinko, Double, Mines, Slots, Wingo, Raspadinha, Caixa Premiada, Envelopes e Bomb), sistema de pagamentos reais via PIX com Mercado Pago, sistema VIP com 5 niveis (Bronze a Diamond), KYC para saques, programa de indicacoes, missaoes diarias, jackpots progressivos, provably fair para todos os jogos, e arquitetura hibrida com Cloudflare Worker na edge e backend Node.js local.
technicalSolution: Construiamos uma plataforma full-stack com frontend Next.js 14 (App Router, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Zustand) em export estatico e backend Express com PostgreSQL via Sequelize, Redis para cache/sessaoes, JWT para autenticacao, Mercado Pago para pagamentos PIX, e Cloudflare Worker como proxy reverso na edge. O backend expoe 50+ rotas REST cobrindo autenticacao, 11 jogos, pagamentos, VIP, KYC, missaoes, indicacoes e administracao. O frontend tem 20+ paginas com 11 jogos interativos, animacaoes Framer Motion, sons, confetti e estado global Zustand com persistencia localStorage. Sistema provably fair com RNG seguro, audit logs, rate limiting, Helmet e validacao Zod.

heroHeadline.pt: Plataforma de jogos online com 11 jogos, sistema VIP de 5 niveis, pagamentos PIX via Mercado Pago, KYC, provably fair e backend Express com PostgreSQL e Redis
heroHeadline.en: Online gaming platform with 11 games, 5-tier VIP system, PIX payments via Mercado Pago, KYC, provably fair and Express backend with PostgreSQL and Redis

heroSubhead.pt: O jogador acessa a plataforma, escolhe entre 11 jogos, deposita via PIX e sobe de nivel VIP. Saques seguros com KYC e resultados verificaveis a cada rodada.
heroSubhead.en: The player opens the platform, picks from 11 games, deposits via PIX and levels up the VIP tier. Secure withdrawals with KYC and verifiable outcomes on every round.

opening.pt: Um jogador abre a TigreBet no navegador. A home page carrega com cards animados de 11 jogos, saldo visivel no header e menu de navegacao. Ele clica em Fortune Tiger, faz sua aposta e acompanha o resultado com animacao de slots e sons. Quando ganha, confetti estoura na tela e o saldo atualiza instantaneamente. Para depositar, gera um QR Code PIX via Mercado Pago, paga no app do banco e em segundos o webhook confirma o pagamento com idempotencia e o saldo cai. Conforme joga, sobe de nivel VIP, desbloqueia missaoes diarias, resgata cashback e participa de jackpots progressivos. Tudo isso com provably fair verificavel, audit logs e rate limiting protegendo cada rota.
opening.en: A player opens TigreBet in their browser. The home page loads with animated cards for 11 games, visible balance in the header and navigation menu. They click Fortune Tiger, place their bet and follow the result with slot animations and sounds. When they win, confetti bursts on screen and the balance updates instantly. To deposit, they generate a PIX QR Code via Mercado Pago, pay in their banking app and within seconds the webhook confirms the payment with idempotency and the balance drops in. As they play, they level up VIP, unlock daily missions, claim cashback and participate in progressive jackpots. All with verifiable provably fair, audit logs and rate limiting protecting every route.

challengeContext.pt: Plataformas de jogos online exigem uma combinacao rara de performance, seguranca e confianca. O frontend precisa ser rapido e envolvente, com animacaoes fluidas e feedback imediato. O backend precisa ser robusto, com transacaoes atomicas, idempotencia de pagamentos, provably fair verificavel e protecao contra fraudes. O sistema de pagamentos precisa integrar com PIX via Mercado Pago, com webhook confiavel e tratamento de falhas. O sistema VIP precisa recompensar jogadores com cashback, bonus e beneficios progressivos. KYC e obrigatorio para saques. E tudo precisa rodar 24/7 com baixa latencia, cache Redis para sessaoes e leaderboards, e PostgreSQL para dados consistentes.
challengeContext.en: Online gaming platforms require a rare combination of performance, security and trust. The frontend needs to be fast and engaging, with fluid animations and immediate feedback. The backend needs to be robust, with atomic transactions, payment idempotency, verifiable provably fair and fraud protection. The payment system needs to integrate with PIX via Mercado Pago, with reliable webhooks and failure handling. The VIP system needs to reward players with cashback, bonuses and progressive benefits. KYC is mandatory for withdrawals. And everything needs to run 24/7 with low latency, Redis cache for sessions and leaderboards, and PostgreSQL for consistent data.

approach.pt: Tratamos a plataforma como um produto de alta escala desde o primeiro dia. Arquitetamos uma solucao em camadas: frontend Next.js 14 com export estatico para maxima performance, backend Express com PostgreSQL via Sequelize para dados consistentes, Redis para cache e sessaoes, e Cloudflare Worker como proxy reverso na edge. Cada jogo foi implementado com provably fair e RNG seguro (crypto). Pagamentos PIX via Mercado Pago com webhook idempotente. Sistema VIP com 5 niveis e cashback progressivo. KYC obrigatorio para saques com aprovacao manual. Rate limiting em 3 niveis (auth, API, jogos). Audit logs para compliance. Validacao Zod em todas as entradas.
approach.en: We treated the platform as a high-scale product from day one. We architected a layered solution: Next.js 14 frontend with static export for maximum performance, Express backend with PostgreSQL via Sequelize for consistent data, Redis for cache and sessions, and Cloudflare Worker as edge reverse proxy. Each game was implemented with provably fair and secure RNG (crypto). PIX payments via Mercado Pago with idempotent webhook. VIP system with 5 tiers and progressive cashback. Mandatory KYC for withdrawals with manual approval. Rate limiting at 3 levels (auth, API, games). Audit logs for compliance. Zod validation on all inputs.

title.pt: Express em vez de NestJS para o backend
title.en: Express instead of NestJS for the backend

why.pt: Express e minimalista, flexivel e tem o maior ecossistema de middleware no Node.js. Para uma plataforma com 50+ rotas e controle fino de middleware (rate limiting, audit, auth, CORS), Express da controle direto sem a verbosidade de decorators e modules do NestJS.
why.en: Express is minimalist, flexible and has the largest middleware ecosystem in Node.js. For a platform with 50+ routes and fine middleware control (rate limiting, audit, auth, CORS), Express gives direct control without the verbosity of NestJS decorators and modules.

alternatives.pt: Avaliamos NestJS, mas a estrutura opinada e a curva de aprendizado nao justificavam o overhead para este projeto.
alternatives.en: We evaluated NestJS, but the opinionated structure and learning curve did not justify the overhead for this project.

title.pt: PostgreSQL com Sequelize em vez de MongoDB
title.en: PostgreSQL with Sequelize instead of MongoDB

why.pt: Transacaoes financeiras exigem consistencia ACID. PostgreSQL garante transacaoes atomicas para depositos, saques e apostas. Sequelize como ORM tipado reduz erros e acelera migrations. O schema relacional encaixa naturalmente em usuarios, transacaoes, apostas e niveis VIP.
why.en: Financial transactions require ACID consistency. PostgreSQL guarantees atomic transactions for deposits, withdrawals and bets. Sequelize as a typed ORM reduces errors and speeds up migrations. The relational schema naturally fits users, transactions, bets and VIP levels.

alternatives.pt: MongoDB seria mais flexivel, mas menos previsivel para joins e transacaoes financeiras. O projeto tinha modelos Mongoose legados que nao foram utilizados.
alternatives.en: MongoDB would be more flexible, but less predictable for joins and financial transactions. The project had legacy Mongoose models that were not used.

title.pt: Cloudflare Worker como proxy em vez de IP publico direto
title.en: Cloudflare Worker as proxy instead of direct public IP

why.pt: O Worker na edge da Cloudflare esconde o IP do backend, adiciona CORS, remove headers Cloudflare e da 503 graceful se o backend estiver offline. Permite trocar o IP do backend sem mudar o frontend — basta atualizar a variavel no wrangler.toml.
why.en: The Cloudflare edge Worker hides the backend IP, adds CORS, removes Cloudflare headers and gives a graceful 503 if the backend is offline. It allows changing the backend IP without changing the frontend — just update the variable in wrangler.toml.

alternatives.pt: IP publico direto exigiria IP fixo, porta aberta no firewall e atualizacao manual no frontend a cada mudanca de IP. O Cloudflare Tunnel foi considerado como alternativa ao Worker.
alternatives.en: Direct public IP would require a fixed IP, open firewall port and manual frontend update on every IP change. Cloudflare Tunnel was considered as an alternative to the Worker.

title.pt: Zustand em vez de Redux para estado global
title.en: Zustand instead of Redux for global state

why.pt: Zustand e leve, sem boilerplate, com persistencia localStorage nativa via middleware. Para uma plataforma com estado de usuario, jogo, VIP e comissao, Zustand resolve com menos codigo e melhor DX que Redux Toolkit.
why.en: Zustand is lightweight, boilerplate-free, with native localStorage persistence via middleware. For a platform with user, game, VIP and commission state, Zustand solves it with less code and better DX than Redux Toolkit.

alternatives.pt: Redux Toolkit seria mais maduro para equipes grandes, mas o boilerplate e a curva de aprendizado nao se justificavam para este projeto.
alternatives.en: Redux Toolkit would be more mature for large teams, but the boilerplate and learning curve were not justified for this project.

myRole.pt: Atuei como tech lead e desenvolvedor full stack: arquitetei a plataforma com Next.js 14 no frontend e Express + PostgreSQL + Redis no backend, implementei os 11 jogos com provably fair e RNG seguro, desenvolvi o sistema de pagamentos PIX via Mercado Pago com webhook idempotente, criei o sistema VIP com 5 niveis e cashback progressivo, implementei KYC, missaoes diarias, jackpots progressivos e audit logs, configurei o Cloudflare Worker como proxy reverso na edge, e desenhei a interface com animacaoes Framer Motion, sons e confetti.
myRole.en: I acted as tech lead and full stack developer: architected the platform with Next.js 14 on the frontend and Express + PostgreSQL + Redis on the backend, implemented the 11 games with provably fair and secure RNG, developed the PIX payment system via Mercado Pago with idempotent webhook, created the VIP system with 5 tiers and progressive cashback, implemented KYC, daily missions, progressive jackpots and audit logs, configured the Cloudflare Worker as edge reverse proxy, and designed the interface with Framer Motion animations, sounds and confetti.

lessonsLearned.pt: O maior aprendizado foi que plataformas de jogos online vivem e morrem pela confianca. Provably fair nao e um feature — e uma obrigacao. Idempotencia de webhook nao e opcional — e o que separa um deposito confirmado de um deposito perdido. E arquitetura hibrida (estatico na edge + backend local) da o melhor dos dois mundos: performance global com controle total do banco. Tambem aprendi que Redis com fallback graceful e melhor que Redis obrigatorio — a plataforma nao pode cair porque o cache caiu.
lessonsLearned.en: The biggest lesson was that online gaming platforms live and die by trust. Provably fair is not a feature — it is an obligation. Webhook idempotency is not optional — it is what separates a confirmed deposit from a lost one. And hybrid architecture (static at the edge + local backend) gives the best of both worlds: global performance with full database control. I also learned that Redis with graceful fallback is better than mandatory Redis — the platform cannot go down because the cache went down.

en.title: Hybrid architecture
items: Next.js 14 frontend with static export deployed on Cloudflare Pages
Cloudflare Worker as edge reverse proxy with CORS and 503 fallback
Express backend on port 5000 with 50+ REST routes and auth/audit/rate-limit middleware
PostgreSQL with 10 tables via Sequelize for users, transactions, bets, VIP and more
Redis for session cache, leaderboards and queues with graceful fallback
Mercado Pago API for PIX deposits with idempotent webhook
JWT for stateless authentication with status verification in middleware
Zustand with localStorage persistence for frontend global state
